probius.Warp Resonance: Quest ramps your Warp Rift explosion damage, your main poke and burst engine, complete it early to two-shot squishies.
probius.Photon Barrier: Free spell armor whenever a cannon is up, keeps fragile Probius alive against mage poke while you hold zone.
probius.Particle Accelerator: Turns a detonated Rift into a 4-pulse nuke, massive burst on a clumped or rooted target after you land pulses.
probius.Pylon Overcharge: Your defensive ult, turns pylons into turrets to wall off a lane and defend a point in a 5v5.
probius.Shield Battery: Pylons shield your whole team, take it over damage when you need to enable a dive or protect the carry.
probius.Quantum Entanglement: Extends the Rift slow so a stepped-on target stays snared long enough for your combo or an ally gank to land.
probius.Construct Additional Pylons: Three pylons means map-wide vision and stacked Overcharge zones, locks down any objective fight.

qhira.Fatal Wounds: Quest ramps your bleed and adds an execute on low targets, the core of Qhira DPS, rush it to snowball.
qhira.Upstage: Evade on hitting 2 heroes with Blood Rage, your survival tool that lets you commit into a bruiser and live.
qhira.The Thirst: Carnage lifesteal plus an empowered follow-up attack, sustains you in duels and chunks the target.
qhira.Unrelenting Strikes: Your teamfight ult, a growing sword that pumps AoE and ends in a burst, take it in grouped fights.
qhira.Chainsaw: Refreshes Carnage while a target is at max bleed, near-permanent access to your gap-close and sustain.
qhira.Lingering Ailment: Armor shred on your grapples, opens the target for your own burst and your team's follow-up.
qhira.Silent Killer: Adds a silence to Unrelenting Strikes, locks down a mobile or channel-reliant target while you shred them.

ragnaros.Shifting Meteor: Ramps Living Meteor damage on repeat hits and quests for more, your poke and waveclear engine, land it repeatedly.
ragnaros.Slow Burn: Blast Wave slow gives you the self-peel and setup to keep meteors landing on a fleeing target.
ragnaros.Hand of Ragnaros: Empower resets fast on 2+ hero hits, near-infinite empowered attacks to shove waves and sustain in brawls.
ragnaros.Sulfuras Smash: Your burst and engage ult, a long-range slam for a pick or to zone, huge center damage on a caught target.
ragnaros.Cauterize Wounds: Empower heals off hero damage, the sustain that lets you brawl on the frontline and hold a losing lane.
ragnaros.Meteor Bomb: Living Meteor explodes for a second hit, a big AoE burst spike that punishes grouped enemies.
ragnaros.Submerge: Your escape and reset, stasis and heal to bait cooldowns then re-engage, survives a full combo dumped on you.

raynor.Ace In The Hole: Bonus damage to slowed targets plus a slow on your knockback, rewards your peel and chunks divers.
raynor.Fight or Flight: Lower cooldown and armor on Adrenaline Rush, the sustain and survival that keeps an immobile carry alive.
raynor.Heavy Slugs: Boosts your only self-peel and poke, take it to shove a diver off you and chunk their frontline from range.
raynor.Hyperion: Big AoE zoning ult that pressures the whole fight and objectives, the standard pick over the raid heroic.
raynor.Line 'Em Up: Cuts Penetrating Round cooldown, more when it hits 2+, near-constant peel and poke in grouped fights.
raynor.Paint Them Red: More Penetrating Round damage plus heavy self-heal, turns your peel into real burst and sustain.
raynor.Execute Orders: Shorter death timer and a free Hyperion on death, keeps you in the game and punishes them for the kill.

rehgar.Colossal Totem: Movable, bigger Earthbind totem, better zoning and lets you re-snare a target as the fight shifts.
rehgar.Earthliving Enchant: Extra heal-over-time when Chain Heal lands on a low ally, big sustain to keep a dived ally alive.
rehgar.Grounded Totem: Adds attack speed and spell power reduction, real teamfight peel against auto-attackers and mages.
rehgar.Ancestral Healing: Your clutch full-heal to deny a pick, bank it for the exact ally they commit onto in a 5v5.
rehgar.Tidal Waves: Chain Heal cooldown and mana drop per hero healed, sustained group healing in drawn-out brawls.
rehgar.Rising Storm: Ramps Lightning Shield damage, adds real waveclear and poke so you are not purely a healbot.
rehgar.Gladiator's War Shout: Doubles Bloodlust duration and range, a fight-winning team steroid over the Ancestral upgrade.

rexxar.Bird of Prey: Boosts Spirit Swoop against minions, the waveclear and soak that lets Rexxar hold a solo lane.
rexxar.Hungry Bear: Misha lifesteals on attacks, keeps your bear alive as a frontline peel wall against dive.
rexxar.Crippling Talons: Big slow upgrade on Spirit Swoop, your primary setup to lock a target for Misha and your team.
rexxar.Bestial Wrath: Massive Misha attack damage for a burst window, your main kill pressure, commit it on a caught target.
rexxar.Aspect of the Hawk: Spirit Swoop grants attack speed extended by Misha, ramps your sustained damage in a long fight.
rexxar.Thrill of the Hunt: Move speed on your attacks, chase down kites and keep Misha stuck on the target.
rexxar.Spirit Bond: Longer Bestial Wrath plus heavy self-heal off Misha, turns your ult window into sustain and survival.

samuro.Way of the Blade: Guaranteed crit every 3rd attack, the reliable damage backbone for your images and split push.
samuro.One With The Wind: Armor during and after Wind Walk, the survivability that makes you nearly unkillable in a dive or escape.
samuro.Burning Blade: Crits add AoE spell damage, boosts your waveclear and cleave in grouped fights.
samuro.Bladestorm: AoE burst plus armor, your teamfight and waveclear ult when you are grouped rather than split.
samuro.Kawarimi: Wind Walk leaves a decoy image that keeps acting, free clone for pressure and the ultimate juke tool.
samuro.Harsh Winds: Attacking out of Wind Walk amps your damage on that target, a huge burst opener on a squishy.
samuro.Wind Strider: Shorter Wind Walk cooldown, more escapes, more Harsh Winds openers, more constant map pressure.

sgthammer.Advanced Artillery: Bigger, harder Siege Mode splash, multiplies your zone and structure pressure, the core of Hammer damage.
sgthammer.Barricade: Cheaper Concussive Blast plus a wall, peel divers off you and block a choke to save your fragile self.
sgthammer.Hover Siege Mode: Move while sieged, the mobility fix for Hammer's biggest weakness so you can reposition under pressure.
sgthammer.Blunt Force Gun: Long-range line nuke for poke and picks, softens the enemy before a fight from total safety.
sgthammer.Tactical Mine Deployment: Mine trail while thrusting, self-peel and area denial that punishes anyone chasing you.
sgthammer.Mechanical Know-how: Shield plus attack damage on Neosteel, survives a dive and spikes your burst window.
sgthammer.Orbital BFG: Blunt Force Gun orbits the map repeatedly, permanent global damage that zones and chips objectives.

sonya.Furious Blow: Free empowered Seismic Slam every 4th cast, sustains your Fury economy and boosts your main damage.
sonya.Shot Of Fury: Instant Fury plus an empowered attack, burst on demand and fixes Fury starvation when you engage.
sonya.Life Funnel: Whirlwind heals for more, the self-sustain that lets Sonya dive in and solo camps between fights.
sonya.Wrath of the Berserker: Damage boost and CC reduction, your engage and bruiser steroid, the standard teamfight ult.
sonya.Mystical Spear: Ancient Spear always pulls you in on a lower cooldown, reliable gap-close and escape even on a miss.
sonya.Giant Slammer: Percent-health damage plus heal on attacks and Slam, melts tanks and sustains you against a beefy frontline.
sonya.Striding Giant: Wrath adds health and an unstoppable button, break CC and survive the focus during your damage window.

stitches.Savor The Flavor: Devour quest ramps regen and Vile Gas damage, the stacking sustain that makes Stitches a real frontline.
stitches.Playtime!: Attacks and Slam refund Slam cooldown, near-constant Slam for waveclear and to keep enemies in your gas.
stitches.Serrated Edge: Hook deals percent damage and refunds cooldown and mana, one hook chunks hard and you hook again sooner.
stitches.Putrid Bile: Self-speed and a slowing damage aura, your engage and chase tool to stick a hooked target and gas the group.
stitches.Meat Hook: Hook heals you big over 5 seconds, the sustain to hook into their team and survive the return focus.
stitches.Pulverize: Slam adds a heavy slow and armor shred, peel for your team and set up your carry to delete the target.
stitches.Gift From The Embalmer: Bile double damage plus a death-timer quest, turns your aura into real damage and fast respawns.

stukov.Fetid Touch: Ranged slowing attacks plus a Weighted Pustule quest, safer poke and the setup to land your combos.
stukov.Biotic Armor: Healing Pathogen grants armor, big on detonate, timed physical mitigation for an ally taking a dive.
stukov.The Long Pitch: Longer Pustule range and a cooldown reset on 2+ detonations, spreads your poke and resets your kit constantly.
stukov.Flailing Swipe: Multi-hit knockback ult, self-peel and disruption to push divers off you and your backline.
stukov.It Hungers: Bigger Lurking Arm that resets on enough hits, your silence arm becomes near-permanent to ruin combo heroes.
stukov.Superstrain: Instant heal when a Pathogen ally is stunned or rooted, counters hard-CC burst on the target they lock.
stukov.Controlled Chaos: Flailing Swipe becomes a spammable max-range poke and peel tool, constant disruption over one big swing.

sylvanas.Might of the Banshee Queen: Stacking attack speed and spell power on hero hits, ramps your DPS the longer you fire in a fight.
sylvanas.Unstable Poison: Dying minions explode, monstrous waveclear and camp clear that fuels Sylvanas's push identity.
sylvanas.Barbed Shot: The 5th Withering Fire on one target hits huge, real single-target burst to actually threaten kills.
sylvanas.Wailing Arrow: Your AoE silence ult, take it to shut off their combo or engage, and it clears a lane instantly.
sylvanas.Cold Embrace: Shadow Dagger shreds armor on spread, opens the whole clumped team for your and allies' follow-up.
sylvanas.Evasive Fire: Move speed on hits, the kiting tool that keeps immobile Sylvanas alive while she pumps damage.
sylvanas.Deafening Blast: Wailing Arrow center hits harder and silences longer, turns your utility ult into burst and lockdown.

tassadar.Psi-Infusion: Longer Psionic Storm that refunds mana on hits, sustainable waveclear and poke that keeps your mana up.
tassadar.Induction: Move speed ramped by Shock Ray, the kiting and repositioning that keeps fragile Tassadar safe.
tassadar.Beam Alignment: Fully charged beam resets Shock Ray fast with a longer slow, chains slows to pin a target under your beam.
tassadar.Archon: Shield plus empowered Resonance Beam, your damage and survival ult that melts tanks and frontline.
tassadar.Feedback: Storm plus beam boosts the slow and shreds armor, your combo that pins a target and amps all your damage.
tassadar.Thermal Lance: Shock Ray adds percent-health damage, extra burst that helps you cut through beefy targets.
tassadar.Twilight Archon: Attacks extend Archon, a long-held Archon window that can carry a whole teamfight.

thebutcher.Invigoration: Hamstring refunds mana and cooldown on a hero, keeps your slow up to stick to the target and chase kills.
thebutcher.Unrelenting Pursuit: Ruthless Onslaught cooldown drops on impact, back-to-back charges to lock down a fleeing target.
thebutcher.Meat Shield: Spell armor on Onslaught impact, eats a burst mage combo as you dive into their backline.
thebutcher.Lamb to the Slaughter: Your pick ult, a post that roots a hero in place, one lamb equals one kill on a caught squishy.
thebutcher.Savage Charge: Onslaught adds percent-health damage, makes your engage chunk tanks and bruisers hard.
thebutcher.Enraged: Attack speed and armor when low, the comeback survivability to finish a fight you dove into hurt.
thebutcher.Nexus Blades: Attacks slow and hit harder, a built-in stick that guarantees your target cannot escape your damage.

thrall.Crash Lightning: Chain Lightning quest ramps its bounce damage, boosts your waveclear and poke throughout the game.
thrall.Feral Resilience: Feral Spirit grants physical armor stacks, timed mitigation that lets Thrall brawl through auto-attackers.
thrall.Follow Through: Next attack after an ability hits harder, the core of your burst rotation, weave abilities into attacks.
thrall.Sundering: Your engage and pick ult, a long stun line that shoves and locks a target, sets up wombo or peels divers.
thrall.Grace Of Air: Windfury grants double resilience stacks, heavy armor uptime that makes you tanky while you cleave.
thrall.Tempest Fury: Windfury's final strike triple-hits, a big burst spike on your main damage ability.
thrall.Wind Rush: Teleport plus Windfury on demand, the mobility and reset to engage, escape, or chase a kill.
